ordering_rule: doc 55 SS19.2 / SS19.7: this file is written BEFORE exp69_datagen.py runs. exp69_datagen.py asserts its existence, so the ordering is mechanised. Rule 4's strong form: the predictions cannot be fitted to a dataset that does not yet exist.

raw_family.sign_pin: REGISTERED: PC signs pinned to the frozen vec2 plane. Bounds are invariant to PC sign; a trained circuit is not.
raw_family.normalisation: REGISTERED: p_k(r) = PC_k(r) / max_{r' in HUMANS} |PC_k(r')| for k = 1, 2. Divisors: PC1 8.669495, PC2 10.160404

plane_agreement_with_frozen2d.verdict: the frozen 2D embeddings ARE the unit-normalised raw PCA plane; FA's angle and the raw-PCA angle are the SAME quantity

radial_coordinate.note: this is exactly the information unit-normalisation destroyed. F2-raw = (PC1, PC2) = (rho cos phi, rho sin phi) carries angle AND radius; FA carries angle only. That is why exp68 on this family is width-as-INFORMATION, not width-as-reparameterisation.

provenance.recompute_mode: RECOMPUTED (full four-category loop, so the non-occupational cells sit on the addendum's own random stream)

category.source: instrument_sb_bounds.CATEGORIES -- doc 54 SS5.2, user-confirmed 2026-08-23; imported, never re-typed

R-A.definition: FA: phi = atan2(p2, p1); u = (1, cos phi, sin phi). d = 3. The EXISTING single-angle map (exp42 intro_convention, angle = atan2(y, x)); scaling-free.
R-A.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND -- readout_arity_bounds's three-stage search (annealed logsumexp surrogate, latent multiclass hinge over a 4-margin ladder, hard-count polish, plus basin hops), SEEDED with the committed per-twin witness so it can never return less than the committed value
R-A.supersession_note: doc 54 SS17.7: this bound moved 0.9250 -> 0.9625 AFTER exp68 reported, and no stored boolean moved with it, because doc 54 SS7 / doc 55 SS6 read no criterion against any bound. The superseded 0.9625 is what doc 55 SS12 carries and what exp69 inherits.
R-A.note_pre_supersession: the null percentile 89.0 in that block is stated against the PRE-supersession 0.9250; it is quoted only for doc 55 SS19.2's grade-3 below-null test, which a supersession UPWARD cannot flip

R-W.definition: F2: two-qubit register, theta0 = SCALE(PC1) on qubit 0, theta1 = SCALE(PC2) on qubit 1, both by theta = (p + 1) * pi        -> [0, 2pi); u = vec(u(theta0) (x) u(theta1)). d = 9.
R-W.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND at d = 9 (same three-stage search, same budget). doc 55 SS12: 'the register bound at d = 9 is a constructive lower bound from a budgeted search -- adequate for design feasibility, NEVER for a criterion' (doc 54 SS16 item 4).

R-M.definition: theta = exp65_featurizer's positional n-gram + PCA angle (atan2 of the 2-D projection, unit-normalised); u = (1, cos theta, sin theta). d = 3.
R-M.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (48 restarts x 500 steps + 6 LS-drop starts)
R-M.source: computed HERE, 2026-08-25, from instrument_sb_bounds + exp65_featurizer -- doc 55 SS19.2's registered value
R-M.featurizer_fit_protocol: doc 55 SS18.4: fit INVENTORY-WIDE over all 24 humans and applied to all 24. This is not leakage in exp69's setting because exp69 holds out PAIRINGS, not nouns -- doc 54's raw-PCA precedent. exp65's train-only rule existed because exp65 held out NOUNS. Stated to preempt the doc-42 failure class.
R-M.membership_source: exp65_featurizer.FAAIL -- doc 51 SS7, user-confirmed; imported, never re-typed

grade2_point_predictions.interval_provenance: 0.06 ~ 2 x the binomial SD at n_test = 300 (sqrt(0.25/300) = 0.02887) -- the bar exp61 SS8 / exp67 SS4 / doc 54 SS7 used, inherited, and the reason exp69's n_test is deliberately 300
grade2_point_predictions.extrapolation_under_test: doc 55 SS19.2: the median comes from n = 13 rows in ONE task family (the single-RY K = 1 / width population) and exp69 is a NEW task family (two composed events, verb-indexed query). THE EXTRAPOLATION IS ITSELF UNDER TEST. A miss refutes the EXTRAPOLATION, not the bound, and may not be reported as the calculus failing.

grade3_under_conversion_flag.flag: under-conversion predicted for a BELOW-NULL category (the F1 observation, made prospective)
grade3_under_conversion_flag.verdict: UNTESTABLE THIS RUN. doc 55 SS19.2 computed this before freezing and recorded it rather than dropping it: no exp69 arm has a below-null category (R-A 89.0th percentile, R-W 85.5th, R-M 100.0th), so the grade-3 flag has nothing to fire on. It is recorded as untestable, NOT as confirmed.

witnesses_doc55_SS19_3.convention: doc 55 SS19.3: the MAX-FS witness C is NOT unique, so the registered convention is the COMMITTED SEARCH'S OUTPUT AT ITS REGISTERED SEED (51000 for R-A / R-W via readout_arity_bounds_addendum.py; 0 for R-M via instrument_sb_bounds.bound), exported at bound-computation time -- i.e. in this file, BEFORE the dataset exists -- with margins computed ONCE and frozen.
witnesses_doc55_SS19_3.margin_formula: margin(twin) = s * <C, phi> / (||C|| ||phi||) with phi = vec(u(agent) (x) u(patient)) AGENT-FIRST and s = +1 for the YES twin, -1 for the NO twin. Scale-free, so the SS19.3 Spearman is invariant to the witness's normalisation.
witnesses_doc55_SS19_3.pair_margin_rule: min over the pair's two twins
witnesses_doc55_SS19_3.registered_analysis: doc 55 SS19.3: Spearman rank correlation between witness margin and PER-ITEM held-out accuracy, per arm. DESCRIPTIVE, with direction (positive expected). At 150 test pairs per arm this has real power, unlike the seed-level descriptives. NO criterion reads it.
witnesses_doc55_SS19_3.registered_caveat: R-W's witness comes from a LOWER-BOUND search at d = 9, so its margins are noisier BY CONSTRUCTION than the d = 3 arms' (doc 55 SS19.3).

R-A.feature_space_note: computed in the INSTRUMENT's FA space (atan2 of the NORMALISED coordinates), which is the space the witness was searched in. The RUNTIME FA angle (doc 54 SS6.2: atan2 of the UNNORMALISED components, i.e. exp42_noun_embeddings) differs by <= ~7.9e-02 rad and preserves the referents' cyclic order, so the d = 3 BOUND is identical either way. Rank agreement between the two margin orderings is measured below.

R-W.feature_space_note: F2's instrument features ARE the runtime features (theta_k = (p_k + 1) pi, outer product), so no space mismatch exists here

R-M.orientation: instrument sign convention (maxfs_lower returns c oriented so that satisfied rows are the positives)
R-M.feature_space_note: the wazn angle is the same quantity at bound time and at runtime

bounds_are_context_only: doc 55 SS6 / SS12: NO criterion in doc 55 SS6 is read against any number in this file. doc 54 SS17.7 is the standing reason -- a bound moved by 0.0375 AFTER exp68 reported and no stored boolean moved with it. These predictions are a PROSPECTIVE TEST OF THE INSTRUMENT, graded, and they arm doc 55 SS9.2's bug-hunt row (any arm exceeding its bound by > 0.06). They are not criteria and may not be promoted onto one.
